title: Milt Gabler and those who loved the music
summary: Milt Gabler came South out of love of the music but was an exception; most were entrepreneurs, and the successful ones were most competitive.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: What the word "jazz" means: origins, Dixieland and labels
